ask.both: Could you send me your order number{order_number_example} and the email address you used for the order{email_example}?
ask.email: Could you send me the email address you used for the order{email_example}?
ask.order_number: Could you send me your order number{order_number_example}?

step_examples.customer: Any news on #1012? My email is sample@example.com.

sentences.no_shipment_details: I do not have a tracking number or a delivery date yet, but tracking usually appears once the carrier picks up and scans the parcel.
sentences.unshipped_rest: The rest of your items have not shipped yet, and I do not have a date for them.
sentences.handoff_offer: Would you like me to connect you with a member of our team?
sentences.reminder_offer: Would you like me to send our team a reminder to ship your order?
sentences.reminder_confirmation: Done. I have sent our team a reminder about your order. Your reference number is <reference>.
sentences.handoff_confirmation: Done. I have passed your request to our team. Your ticket number is <ticket>, and a member of our team will take it from here.
sentences.decline_reply: Sorry, I can only help with order and delivery questions at Gisting Lab Store.
sentences.decline_ack: No problem. Let me know if there is anything else I can help with.

transport_status.IN_TRANSIT: Your order {words}. It is with <carrier>, tracking number <tracking number>. Expected delivery: <month name and day, like March 9>.
transport_status.OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: Your order {words}. It is with <carrier>, tracking number <tracking number>. Expected delivery: <month name and day, like March 9>.
transport_status.DELAYED: Your order {words}. It is with <carrier>, tracking number <tracking number>. Expected delivery: <month name and day, like March 9>. {thanks_patience} {handoff_offer}
transport_status.ATTEMPTED_DELIVERY: Sorry, {words}. It is with <carrier>, tracking number <tracking number>. Expected delivery: <month name and day, like March 9>. {handoff_offer}
transport_status.DELIVERED: Your order {words}. It was sent with <carrier>, tracking number <tracking number>. Delivered on <month name and day, like March 9>.

fulfillment_status.UNFULFILLED: Your order {words}, so I do not have a delivery date. {reminder_offer}

failure_replies.no_match: I couldn't find an order matching that order number and email. Please check both and try again.
failure_replies.unavailable: Sorry, order lookup is not available right now. Please try again in a little while. {handoff_offer}
failure_replies.locked: Order lookups are locked for this chat after too many unsuccessful attempts. {handoff_offer}

parcel_missing.date: but I do not have a delivery date{for_it} yet
parcel_missing.tracking: but I do not have a tracking number{for_it} yet
parcel_missing.both: but I do not have a tracking number or a delivery date{for_it} yet

many_parcels_reply: Your order was sent in several parcels, so the details are too long to list here. {handoff_offer}
